finding.summary: The new allOf constraint requires finding.line for raise_true_bug and skip_false_bug actions, with a comment stating findings are 'matched by its line at raised_sha'. However, raised_sha remains nullable (type: ["string", "null"]) and is not required for these action types. A case could pass schema validation with finding.line set but raised_sha: null, which would fail at runtime since the evaluation harness runs at raised_sha commits per the PR description.
finding.fix: Add "raised_sha" to the required array in the then clause of the new allOf entry, so both finding and raised_sha are required for raise_true_bug and skip_false_bug actions. This ensures the schema enforces the same precondition that the evaluation runtime requires.

label: real_issue
label_reason: Commit 02d37e7 in the PR cites finding R45-fee8a9a-012.
